essential_caveats: Full 30-team seasonal rosters, not actual playoff appearance lists or a complete contract archive.
Roster scope complete does not mean rating completeness; null is unknown and never zero.
Jerseys are strings; 0 differs from 00. Snapshot labels are not season history.
Only audited exact identities and explicit aliases; transaction-only records do not establish appearances or chronology.
Edition-specific historical sources vary in date; no shared final-roster or game-patch date is claimed.
Published non-null ratings and their sources remain unchanged; null fills appear in the expansion change audit.
Blacktop derived cats are excluded; source categories remain null without original display values.
